text:
Carmen L: Follow-up from the DB replica thrash postmortem. Main goal: reduce noisy replicas pages while keeping visibility for real replication lag issues.
Noah P: sounds good. small steps preferred.
Carmen L: proposed actions: 1) bump p95 -> p99 for bulk-replica lag alerts for read-only replicas; 2) per-replica dedupe signature + 10m suppression; 3) scheduled suppression during predictable backups; 4) weekly sweep for recurring offenders.
Sana R: i'll own the suppression during backups and the backup whitelist. will ensure suppression is keyed by backup-job-id.
Noah P: i'll do thresholds analysis. i'll run 90/95/99 percentiles over 60 days and propose cutoffs + expected page delta.
Sana R: dedupe signature plan: "{{cluster}}:{{replica}}:replication_lag_bucket". will implement in alerts repo under alerts/db/replication. test alert snippet for staging:
```
alert: db_replica_p99_lag
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(db_replica_lag_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster, replica)) > 1.5
for: 4m
labels:
  severity: paged
annotations:
  signature: '{{ $labels.cluster }}:{{ $labels.replica }}:replication_lag'
```
Carmen L: owners & deadlines: Sana - suppression + whitelist PR due 2025-03-10; Noah - threshold PR due 2025-03-09; Carmen - canary plan + runbook update due 2025-03-11.
alert-bot: (automated) Incident#4890 marked resolved by carmen.l  follow-up task 'db-replica-noise' created
Noah P: suggestion: tag tuned alerts with label "tuned-mar2025" and add a banner in Slack notif for 2 weeks so oncall knows these are tuned values.
Sana R: will add label and ensure notifications include it. also will exclude suppression during deploy tags.
Carmen L: schedule weekly 2-week sweep rotation for the first 6 weeks after rollout. volunteers?
Noah P: i'll take weeks 1 & 4.
Sana R: i'll take weeks 2 & 5.
Carmen L: please reply 'ack' when you've added tasks to the project board and linked PRs in this thread.
Noah P: ack - adding PR link when ready.
Sana R: ack - will post whitelist PR and staging run results here.
Carmen L: thanks all. quick reminder: keep suppression conservative; prefer per-replica dedupe over global to avoid masking cross-replica outages.
